segments.text: She is the chief of the investigation section of the Preparation Office for Crackdown on Crimes of Power under the Ministry of Law and Order.
It is a newly established department with a very small number of staff, and Eri is dissatisfied with the fact that, contrary to its grand name, it is not expected to do any major work.
Like others, Eri has used her connections to get to her current position, but she is quite talented.

She is always calm and collected, has an elegant smile, and is a flexible person who can handle anything in an adult manner, but she has a strong sense of justice hidden inside, and she wants to eventually elevate the Preparation Office to an investigation office to secure personnel and strengthen crackdown.

Her father is Takaaki Ikeda, a bureaucrat in the Ministry of Law and Order who had close ties with the former prime minister, and she is not particularly happy with the current administration, but she is uncooperative in many ways because she believes that ``Kazuki is a fool, just a prodigal son, unlike his father.''
Eri is used by Kazuki to get Takaaki to move.
法令省傘下の権力犯罪取締準備室捜査係長。
コネで増え続ける公務員の割当先としてまだ出来たばかりのごく少人数の部署であり、大層な名称とは裏腹に大掛かりな仕事は期待されていない点を英理は不満に思っている。
他の例に漏れず英理もコネを利用して現在の地位を手に入れているが、能力的にはかなり優秀な人物。
常に冷静沈着で優雅な笑みを湛え、何事にも大人な対応が可能な融通の利く性格ではあるものの秘めた正義感は強く、いずれは準備室を捜査室へと昇華させて人員確保や取締り強化を行いたいと考えている。
父親は前総理と繋がりの深かった法令省官僚【池田　孝明（いけだ　たかあき）】で、決して現政権を快く受け入れているわけではないが、『和輝は父親と違ってうつけ者、ただの放蕩息子だ』と思い込んでいるため、何かと非協力的。
孝明を動かすため、英理は和輝に利用される。
能力：【白銀の着装（シルバーヒーロー）】
法令省傘下【権力犯罪取締捜査室】の捜査係長。
【ネオ・オオサカシティ】で政治的事件の捜査中に【神の鉄槌】に遭い、能力者として覚醒した。
特殊な電磁場で隔絶されている【ネオ・オオサカシティ】において、外部と連絡を取る手段を持つ稀有な存在。
【権力犯罪取締捜査室】の命でそのまま【ネオ・オオサカシティ】
内の調査と情報収集を行っており、普段は集落を離れての単独行動が多い。
最初は集落の人間達を自身の活動の足枷になると考えていたが、今では熱狂的な支持をくれる彼らを守ることも己の使命のひとつと位置づけて持ち前のリーダーシップとカリスマ性で率いている。
常に冷静沈着で優雅な笑みを崩さず、いかなる事態にも的確な対応を見せる柔軟さを持つ。
しかし内心では強い正義感を持っており、仲間のフリをして近づき相手を油断させ、最終的には犯罪者を追い詰めて裁きを受けさせるなどの執拗さも持ち合わせている。

She is the granddaughter of the current Prime Minister, Kozo Takaida.
She is a third-year student at Kurasaki Academy and is the student council president.
She respects her family, who are all politicians, especially her grandfather, who is also the Prime Minister, and believes that he is an honest, upstanding, and ideal politician like no other.
She grew up in a home where she lacked nothing, has excellent grades, is good at sports, is cheerful, and has many friends.
However, most of her friends draw a line around her being the Prime Minister's granddaughter, and she has no one she can call her best friend.

Although she is not clearly aware of the people around her being considerate of her, she does feel a sense of loneliness, and since she started living with Kagari, she feels like she has found a best friend.
As a result of being raised as a sheltered daughter, she ends up falling into the hands of Kazuki.
現総理【高井田 幸造】の孫娘。
蔵崎（くらさき）学院に通う三年生で、生徒会長。
政治家である家族、特に総理である祖父を尊敬しており、清廉潔白で過去に例のない理想の政治家だと思い込んでいる。
何不自由のない家庭で育ち、成績優秀で運動神経も良く、明朗快活で友人も多い。
ただし『総理の孫娘』という点で一線を引いている友人関係が多く、親友と呼べる人間はいない。
本人は周囲に気を遣われている事にはっきりと気づいてはいないが、どことなく寂しさのようなものは感じており、篝と同居するようになってからは親友が出来たような気分でいる。
箱入り娘として育てられてしまった結果、和輝の手に落ちる事になってしまう。

Kazuki's younger sister, a few years younger than him.
She looked up to her brother and was very attached to him, but they haven't seen each other since he was imprisoned.
She is strong-willed and has lived her life despite the misfortunes of her family,
but her original lively personality has faded.
She is currently taken in by the Takaida family and attends Kurasaki Academy with Yayoi.
At first, she felt annoyed by Yayoi, who was unaware that she was being taken in as a hostage, and by Yayoi's mother, who warmly welcomed her, but she is gradually beginning to like them less.

After being released from prison, she was shocked by the news of her brother's death and tended to withdraw into herself, but at the same time she was relieved to hear that he was alive, she was also torn between the Takaida family and the two parties involved, which caused her anguish.
少し歳の離れた和輝の妹。
兄に憧れてよく懐いていたが、兄が投獄されて以来会っていない。
芯が強く、家族の不幸にもめげず生きているが、
さすがに本来の活発な性格は鳴りを潜めてしまっている。
現在は高井田家に引き取られ、弥生と共に蔵崎学院に通っている。
人質同然で引き取られている事を知らないまま慕ってくる弥生や、温かく自分を受け入れる弥生の母を最初は内心で疎ましく思っていたが、だんだん憎めなくなりつつある。
出所した後の兄の訃報にショックを受けて引き篭もりがちになっていたが、生存を確認して安堵すると同時に高井田家との板挟みになり、苦悩することになる。

She is the fiancee of the second-generation president of Okami Pharmaceutical, which donates to the Civil Rights Party , and a senior researcher.
She is a proud beauty, and a highly skilled pharmacist.
She hates to lose, has a strong desire for honor, and is a capable senior researcher, so she is always surrounded by people.
In particular, she has a dignified aura that rarely loses steam, so she has many female friends.

She is annoyed by Kazuki, who shows no interest in her (or pretends not to), and as she tries to show off at every opportunity in an attempt to get him to notice her, she becomes fascinated by Kazuki's wild charm, which is different from her serious and boring fiance.

二代目社長の婚約者にして、主任研究員。
プライドの高い美人で、高い薬剤師としての腕を持つ。
負けず嫌いで名誉欲が強く、有能な主任研究員という立場もあって常に周囲には取り巻きがいる。

She is the daughter of the representative of the Shoseikai, a religious organization supporting the Koheito, which will form a coalition government with the Civil Rights Party.
She is not the type to show her emotions, and speaks in a monotone.
She is a girl who says what she thinks, and although she is not particularly friendly, she does not have trouble communicating with others.

When she is quiet, she is a normal girl, but because the way the cult thinks has become commonplace, she will call other religions "heretical cults" without any ill intentions, and will casually say to people who have suffered misfortune that "they did not have enough faith." The words of her father, the cult's representative, are absolute as the spokesperson for God.

Mutsumi's youth and beauty are the perfect poster child for spreading the cult's authority, and she is used to retain and secure believers, called "members," but she herself only thinks of them as "useful."
【民権党】と連立政権を樹立する【幸平党（こうへいとう）】
の支援宗教団体【翔世会（しょうせいかい）】代表の娘。
あまり感情を表に出すタイプではなく、淡々とした口調で話す少女。
思った事をそのまま口にしてしまう性格で、決して人当たりが良いとはいえないものの、他人とのコミュニケーションに困るというほどでもない。
黙っていれば普通の少女だが、教団の考え方が当たり前になってしまっているため、あまり悪気もなく他の宗教を『邪教』と呼び、不幸のあった人間に対して『信心が足らなかった』などと平然と口にしてしまうところがある。
父親である教団代表の言葉は神の代弁として絶対のものとなっている。
睦美の若さと美しさは教団の権威を広める上で絶好の広告塔となっており、【会員】と呼ばれる信者の繋ぎ止めや確保に利用されているが、当人は『役に立てている』程度にしか考えていない。

The daughter of a bureaucrat in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, she is a popular young fashion model, talent, and actress.
She also works as a weather presenter on Dainichi TV.

Some people secretly criticize her for not having any talent as an actress or presenter, and for being an entertainer without any clear goals or passion, but her good looks and gentle demeanor are surprisingly popular with viewers, and thanks to her strong connections, people around her treat her like a sore thumb.

However, she is enthusiastic about her work as a symbol of the public interest foundation JUDEMO (Japanese urgent disaster emergency measures organization), and in particular, she is always calling for support for children and the eradication of sexual crimes.
The reason behind this is her fastidious personality, which was influenced by her upbringing, where she used her permissive parents as bad examples.

Naturally, JUDEMO has strong ties with bureaucrats in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and has become a hotbed of retired government officials. Not only does it make money by diverting the donations it collects, it also serves as a source of funding for the Civil Rights Party's activities. However, Koi is unaware of this fact and is being used as an image character.
外件省官僚の娘にして、人気若手ファッションモデル兼タレントであり女優。
大日テレビでお天気キャスターも務めている。
女優やキャスターとしての才能は皆無に等しく、特に明確な目標や情熱も持たず流されるまま芸能人をやっている恋を陰で罵る者もいるが、見た目の良さとおっとりとした雰囲気が意外と茶の間に受けが良く、強力なコネのせいもあって周囲は腫れ物に触わるような扱いをしている。
ただしそんな中でも公益財団法人【JUDEMO（Japanese urgentdisaster emergency measures organization＝日本緊急災害救急対策機関）】のシンボルとしての活動には熱心で、中でも子供たちへの支援や性犯罪撲滅を常日頃から訴えかけている。
その背景には、性に緩い両親を反面教師として育ったための潔癖な性格が影響している。
当然ながら【JUDEMO】は外件省官僚との繋がりも強く天下りの巣窟となっていて、集めた寄付金を横流しする事で潤っている上に【民権党】の活動資金源にもなっているが、恋はその事実を知らず、イメージキャラクターとして利用されている。

His real name is Kazuki Tsukamoto, the son of former Prime Minister Moritaka Tsukamoto.

His father was killed by the current Prime Minister Kozo Takaida, and he was put in solitary confinement for the crime. However, thanks to his talented right-hand man Saki, he was released due to insufficient evidence.
However, he was kept under surveillance even after his release, and his sister was taken in by Takaida and is essentially a hostage.
To gain complete freedom, Kazuki fakes his death in an accident, disappears, has plastic surgery, changes his name, and begins a new life using what his father left behind and his own connections.
He commands women with his somewhat violent charm, which combines wildness and intelligence, and also makes those who looked down on him submit.
前総理大臣【塚本 守孝（つかもと　もりたか）】の息子で、本名は【塚本 一樹（つかもと　かずき）】。
現総理大臣【高井田 幸造（たかいだ　こうぞう）】の策略によって父親を殺され、その罪を負わされて独房に入れられていたが、優秀な片腕である沙希の働きで証拠不十分として釈放される。
ただし釈放後も監視下に置かれ、妹は高井田の下に引き取られて実質人質状態となっている。
まずは完全に自由の身となるため、一樹は事故死を装って姿をくらまし、整形して名を変え、父親の残したものや自身のコネを使って新たな人生を歩み始める。
その野性と知性を兼ね添えたどこか暴力的な魅力で女を従えつつ、自身を軽く見ていた連中をも屈服させていく。

She is the youngest daughter of Takatsuki Seiichi, who served Kazuki's father.
Due to their fathers' friendship, Kazuki and Saki have known each other since childhood.
She is usually cool and doesn't change her expression, and is the only person who can tell Kazuki off, but no matter how she is treated, she has a strong love and loyalty for Kazuki.

This is not just because her father instilled loyalty to the Tsukamoto family in her, but also because she has admired Kazuki since childhood and is grateful to him for saving her life, and it has even become her "meaning of life" that has been accumulated through all sorts of events.

The Takatsuki family has served the Tsukamoto family for generations, but her three older sisters did not want to take over Seiichi's business and married into ordinary families, while Saki's desire was strong, so she became the heir and serves Kazuki.

Saki's father has commanded her to "leave an heir of noble bloodline and never cut ties with the Tsukamoto family," but she only has eyes for Kazuki and thinks to herself that "the Tsukamoto family also falls into the category of noble families."
和輝の父に仕えていた【高槻　誠一（たかつき　せいいち）】の末娘。
父親同士の親交の都合上、和輝と沙希も付き合いは幼少期からと長い。
普段はクールでピクリとも表情を変えず、和輝に対して釘を刺す事の出来る唯一の人物でもあるが、どのような扱いを受けようとも和輝に対する愛情と忠誠心は高い。
それは塚本家に対する忠誠を父親から植え付けられたからというだけではなく、幼少期からの和輝に対する憧れや、かつて命を救われた恩義など、あらゆる経緯が積み重なって出来た『生きる意味』にすらなっている。
高槻家は代々塚本家に仕えているが、歳の離れた三人の姉は誠一の跡を継ぎたがらず一般家庭に嫁いでしまい、逆に沙希の希望が強かったため跡継ぎとなって和輝に仕えている。

He is the current Prime Minister and Yayoi's grandfather.
Thanks to his wife working for a major company, he gained authority within the Minkento Party and rose to the position of leader.

For many years, he had been suffering under the influence of the largest political party, the Shinminto Party, but when the overly strict Tsukamoto became leader and prime minister, he seized the opportunity and used a conspiracy to drive Tsukamoto to his death and take his place.

Like most politicians, he has a strong obsession with money and fame, and is a ruthless person who will do anything to achieve his goals, but he loves his daughter and granddaughter and does not want to show them his dirty side.
Because of this, he raised his daughter and granddaughter in a sheltered environment, which made him a target for Kazuki.

The Tsukamoto and Takatsuki families have a long relationship, with generations of politicians and secretaries on friendly terms, and Seiichi is no exception, showing great friendship and loyalty to Moritaka.

He deeply regrets that Moritaka lost his life despite being with him, and, believing that "we must protect Moritaka's son at least," he did everything in his power to secure Kazuki's release, along with his daughter Saki.

He thoroughly taught Saki about the history and relationship with the Tsukamoto family, telling her to be loyal throughout her life and to produce an heir so as not to break the relationship between the two families.

He is the representative of the "Shoseikai", a religious group that supports the Kohei Party.

He prides himself on being God's representative, stating that contributing to peace and rescuing the poor are roles given to him by God, and he has enthusiastic support from members nationwide due to the mysterious charisma of his daughter Mutsumi.

However, he has also been criticized by both his followers and outside for his aggressive solicitation, strict rules that do not allow withdrawal, ties with political groups that could lead to interference in politics, and income from his position as a religious corporation.
He also runs a school called "Shosei Gakuen" and serves as its chairman.

He is a very stubborn person, and many politicians do not want to get close to him. He

is not particularly happy with the current administration, but he believes that the results will be the same no matter which party takes power, and has not shown any proactive moves since former Prime Minister Tsukamoto passed away.

segments.text: A pure-bred Russian beauty with fair skin and big breasts.
She is an intelligence agent dispatched to Japan on a mission from the Russian Foreign Intelligence Service.

Her role is to "quickly detect and prevent the actions of groups attempting to intervene in the Northern Territories." Particularly concerning for Russia is the presence of such groups in Hokkaido, and since she needs a public face, she has been assigned as the Deputy Consul General at the Russian Consulate General in Sapporo for the past three years.

Although Tatyana understands the importance of her mission, she secretly feels jealous of her colleagues—agents sent to the Russian Embassy in Tokyo for "gathering information on diplomatic negotiations," who seem to be in more glamorous positions.
